disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 检查了插件对本地敏感文件的读取面：仅读取 Gitee OAuth 的 client_id/client_secret/token（存放在 DSH 主目录下专用文件、权限 0600）与 GitHub 登录令牌文件（github-auth.json），均用于对应平台 API 调用的身份标识，未发现向任何非业务地址回传的路径。
checked_items.en: Checked the plugin's read surface for local sensitive files: it only reads Gitee OAuth client_id/client_secret/token (stored in a dedicated file under the DSH home directory, with permission 0600) and the GitHub login token file (github-auth.json), both used as identity for corresponding platform API calls. No path that exfiltrates to any non-business address was found.

checked_items.zh: 敏感路径读取类机械命中（DSH-C01 / DSH-C02 相关扫描）经人工复核为零命中，无对系统凭据目录、SSH 私钥、云凭据文件的访问代码；Gitee secret 在服务端脱敏，绝不下发浏览器。
checked_items.en: Mechanical hits for sensitive-path reads (DSH-C01 / DSH-C02 related scans) were manually reviewed and are zero hits; there is no code accessing system credential directories, SSH private keys, or cloud credential files. Gitee secret is masked server-side and never sent to the browser.

checked_items.zh: 未检出硬编码密钥、云凭据枚举命令、钱包/助记词/私钥访问等窃取类行为（对应规则 DSH-C01、DSH-C02、DSH-C04 均无恶意证据）。
checked_items.en: No hardcoded credentials, cloud credential enumeration commands, or wallet/mnemonic/private-key access theft behaviors were detected (rules DSH-C01, DSH-C02, DSH-C04 all show no malicious evidence).

evidence.zh: 插件确实读取本地凭据（Gitee OAuth 与 GitHub token），但用途仅为相应平台的 API 身份校验，读取后仅用于向用户已配置的软件源发起请求，未发现凭据随网络外发的链路（对照出站地址清单与凭据读取点，二者无交汇）。
evidence.en: The plugin does read local credentials (Gitee OAuth and GitHub token), but only for API identity verification on the corresponding platforms. After reading, they are used only to make requests to user-configured software sources; no chain for exfiltrating credentials over the network was found (comparing the outbound address list with credential read points, they do not intersect).

checked_items.zh: 通读了 README（中英）、更新日志、客户端界面文案与源码注释，未发现指令覆写、系统消息伪装、隐藏 HTML 指令、远程指令加载等注入措辞（对应模型面指令文件规则 DSH-X10 无命中，仓库内无 AGENTS.md / SKILL.md / 点目录指令文件）。
checked_items.en: Read through the README (Chinese and English), changelog, client UI copy, and source comments; no injection wording such as instruction overwriting, system message spoofing, hidden HTML instructions, or remote instruction loading was found (rule DSH-X10 for model-side instruction files has no hits; no AGENTS.md / SKILL.md / dot-directory instruction files are present in the repository).

checked_items.zh: 本插件不向模型注册任何工具描述或系统提示片段（只注册 Web 路由与设置页 UI 插槽），工具描述投毒场景不适用；文档中「安装」「框架升级」等措辞均为正常功能说明，无诱导模型自动执行隐藏动作的表述。
checked_items.en: This plugin does not register any tool description or system prompt fragments to the model (it only registers Web routes and settings page UI slots), so the tool description poisoning scenario is not applicable. Wording such as "install" and "framework upgrade" in documentation are normal functional descriptions, with no text inducing the model to automatically execute hidden actions.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 AI 兜底安装时注入子代理的提示词：内容为限定目标的安装步骤与安全约束（禁止杀进程、禁止重启、禁止改动无关文件），且该功能必须在用户明确授权的弹窗确认后才执行。
checked_items.en: Checked the prompt injected into the sub-agent during AI fallback installation: it contains installation steps and safety constraints scoped to the goal (no process killing, no restarts, no modification of unrelated files), and this feature only runs after an explicit user-authorized popup confirmation.

evidence.zh: 不适用：该插件不注册任何面向 LLM 的工具，无工具描述进入模型请求，不存在工具描述投毒面。
evidence.en: Not applicable: this plugin does not register any tool for LLMs, no tool descriptions enter model requests, so there is no tool description poisoning surface.

evidence.zh: 插件自身是安装/升级管理器（其业务即安装插件），但未发现用注入措辞诱导模型自动执行安装或改写配置的文本；安装与升级动作全部由用户在界面点击触发，AI 兜底也置于授权弹窗之后。
evidence.en: The plugin itself is an install/upgrade manager (its business is installing plugins), but no text with injection wording that induces the model to automatically install or modify configuration was found. Installation and upgrade actions are all triggered by user clicks in the UI, and the AI fallback is also placed behind an authorization popup.

checked_items.zh: 全树扫描未发现 eval / new Function / 动态解码后执行（对应规则 DSH-X06、DSH-X09 零命中）。
checked_items.en: Full-tree scan found no eval / new Function / dynamic decode-then-execute (rules DSH-X06, DSH-X09 have zero hits).

checked_items.zh: 子进程调用（对应规则 DSH-X03 命中）全部人工复核为良性：所有命令以参数数组方式执行（pnpm、git、curl、tar、powershell、schtasks），无 shell 拼接注入面，用途均为已声明的安装、升级、重启、市场数据获取业务。
checked_items.en: Subprocess calls (rule DSH-X03 hit) were all manually reviewed as benign: all commands execute with argument arrays (pnpm, git, curl, tar, powershell, schtasks), no shell concatenation injection surface, and usage is limited to the declared business of install, upgrade, restart, and marketplace data fetching.

checked_items.zh: 挂载配置 cordis.patch.yml 仅为普通 insert 条目，不含 !!js 可执行标量（对应规则 DSH-P01、DSH-P02 零命中）；安装清单无 preinstall/install/postinstall 钩子（对应规则 DSH-X02 零命中）。
checked_items.en: The patch config cordis.patch.yml contains only ordinary insert entries, no !!js executable scalars (rules DSH-P01, DSH-P02 have zero hits); the install manifest has no preinstall/install/postinstall hooks (rule DSH-X02 has zero hits).

checked_items.zh: 仓库 CI 工作流（对应规则 DSH-X07 命中）经复核为良性排除：仅定时重建市场索引并提交，运行于作者仓库的 GitHub Actions，不进入用户机器执行面。
checked_items.en: The repository CI workflow (rule DSH-X07 hit) was reviewed and excluded as benign: it only periodically rebuilds the marketplace index and commits it, runs on the author's repository GitHub Actions, and does not enter the user machine's execution surface.

checked_items.zh: 客户端 bundle（对应规则 DSH-X05、DSH-X08 命中）经复核为良性排除：剪贴板仅用于「复制安装命令」按钮，超长行是内联 CSS 常量而非混淆逻辑。
checked_items.en: The client bundle (rules DSH-X05, DSH-X08 hit) was reviewed and excluded as benign: the clipboard is used only for the "copy install command" button, and the over-long lines are inline CSS constants, not obfuscated logic.

checked_items.zh: 留痕：插件启动后会对宿主框架文件（@deepseek-ai/dsh-app-boot/lib/index.js）自动打一个窄范围容错补丁（改写 parsePatchList 的解析失败分支并注入辅助函数），幂等、先备份、改动内容为固定字符串且文档公开；经分析为良性机制，不是恶意代码改写。
checked_items.en: Tracking: after plugin startup, a narrow scope error-tolerance patch is automatically applied to the host framework file (@deepseek-ai/dsh-app-boot/lib/index.js) (rewrites the parsePatchList parsing failure branch and injects helper functions). It is idempotent, backs up first, the changes are fixed strings and documented publicly; analysis shows it is a benign mechanism, not malicious code modification.

evidence.zh: bundle 补丁文件 cordis.patch.yml 只含普通 insert 条目（插入插件控制台自身），不含 !!js 可执行标量，不存在 patch 即执行风险。
evidence.en: The bundle patch file cordis.patch.yml contains only ordinary insert entries (inserting the plugin console itself), no !!js executable scalars, so there is no patch-as-execution risk.

evidence.zh: 未发现对 cordis_define / cordis_run 等动态包工具的调用（对应规则 DSH-X01 零命中）；插件通过宿主 subagents 服务拉起 AI 子代理仅用于安装修复，且经授权弹窗把关。
evidence.en: No calls to dynamic package tools such as cordis_define / cordis_run were found (rule DSH-X01 has zero hits); the plugin uses the host subagents service to start AI sub-agents only for installation repair, and it is gated by an authorization popup.

evidence.zh: 安装清单无任何 install/prepare 钩子（对应规则 DSH-X02 零命中）；树内执行载体（CI 工作流）仅在作者仓库维护索引，与用户安装执行面无关；git 安装通道由宿主官方命令管理。
evidence.en: The install manifest has no install/prepare hooks (rule DSH-X02 has zero hits); the in-tree execution vehicle (CI workflow) only maintains the index in the author's repository, unrelated to the user installation execution surface; the git installation channel is managed by the host's official commands.

evidence.zh: manifest 声明了 dsh.client，客户端 bundle 已专项检查：仅发现剪贴板复制、DOM 样式注入等常规 UI 行为（对应规则 DSH-X05 命中项均为复制安装命令功能），无键盘监听、无浏览器凭据 RPC 调用、无异常外联。
evidence.en: The manifest declares dsh.client, and the client bundle has been specially inspected: only normal UI behaviors such as clipboard copy and DOM style injection were found (the DSH-X05 hits are all the copy install command feature); no keyboard listeners, no browser credential RPC calls, no anomalous outbound connections.

checked_items.zh: 枚举了全部出站地址：仅 GitHub（api/raw/codeload）、Gitee（OAuth/API）、npm 镜像源（npmmirror/npmjs）、jsDelivr CDN 及公开 GitHub 镜像代理（ghproxy 等），全部服务于市场浏览、插件/技能安装、版本检测与框架升级，未发现裸 IP、未知域名或隐藏信标。
checked_items.en: Enumerated all outbound addresses: only GitHub (api/raw/codeload), Gitee (OAuth/API), npm mirror sources (npmmirror/npmjs), jsDelivr CDN, and public GitHub mirror proxies (ghproxy, etc.), all serving marketplace browsing, plugin/skill installation, version detection, and framework upgrade. No raw IPs, unknown domains, or hidden beacons were found.

checked_items.zh: curl 相关全部命中（对应规则 DSH-C05）经逐点复核为良性排除：curl 仅作为 HTTP 客户端与 tarball 下载器（含 pnpm 网络黑洞时的安装兜底），TLS 校验完整（当前代码无 --insecure、无关闭证书校验），未发现把凭据随 curl 外发的代码路径。
checked_items.en: All curl-related hits (rule DSH-C05) were point-by-point reviewed as benign exclusions: curl is only used as an HTTP client and tarball downloader (including as an install fallback when pnpm network is blocked), TLS verification is complete (current code has no --insecure, no disabled certificate verification), and no code path that sends credentials via curl was found.

checked_items.zh: 未发现编码变换后外发、DNS 隧道、webhook/paste 类带外通道或 AI 端点/代理劫持（对应规则 DSH-C03、DSH-C04 及端点劫持面零恶意证据）；自定义软件源的认证头仅发送至用户自行配置的该源地址。
checked_items.en: No encoded-transform exfiltration, DNS tunneling, webhook/paste out-of-band channels, or AI endpoint/proxy hijacking were found (rules DSH-C03, DSH-C04, and the endpoint hijack surface show zero malicious evidence); the custom software source auth header is sent only to the user's self-configured source address.

evidence.zh: 出站连接均为声明业务所需域名；凭据（Gitee token、GitHub token）只用于对应平台 API 的身份校验，未发现凭据读取点与网络外发点交汇的外泄链（对应规则 DSH-C03、DSH-C04、DSH-C05 全部复核为良性）。
evidence.en: All outbound connections go to domains required by the declared business; credentials (Gitee token, GitHub token) are used only for API identity verification on the corresponding platforms. No exfiltration chain where credential read points and network outbound points intersect was found (rules DSH-C03, DSH-C04, DSH-C05 all reviewed as benign).

checked_items.zh: 检查了补丁写入行为（对应规则 DSH-P03、DSH-P04、DSH-P05 零命中）：插件对补丁文件的启停/删除操作设有宿主基础设施行保护名单，禁止开关删除核心安全与传输组件；未发现改写 inject/intercept 配置或降权写法。
checked_items.en: Checked patch write behavior (rules DSH-P03, DSH-P04, DSH-P05 have zero hits): the plugin has a host infrastructure row protection list for enable/disable/delete operations on patch files, blocking toggling or deletion of core security and transport components; no modification of inject/intercept configurations or privilege-lowering writes were found.

checked_items.zh: 未发现对安全事件的高优先级监听或审批链截断（对应规则 DSH-S01 零命中）；未自行监听网络端口（对应规则 DSH-S03 零命中，路由挂在宿主 webServer 下）。
checked_items.en: No high-priority listeners for security events or approval chain truncation were found (rule DSH-S01 has zero hits); no self-listening network ports (rule DSH-S03 has zero hits, routes hang under the host webServer).

checked_items.zh: 依赖面极简（运行时仅用 Node 内置模块，无第三方依赖），无 typosquatting 面、无可变 git 引用依赖（对应规则 DSH-S04 零命中）；作者为普通个人账号，未发现改名、历史抹除等异常信号。
checked_items.en: The dependency surface is minimal (runtime uses only Node built-in modules, no third-party dependencies), no typosquatting surface, no mutable git reference dependencies (rule DSH-S04 has zero hits); the author is a regular personal account, no abnormal signals such as renaming or history removal were found.

checked_items.zh: 首次审计无版本基线，升级自动激活比对不适用（对应规则 DSH-S02）；插件自身的「检测更新/自更新」从 npm 官方镜像拉取并做版本比较，属透明声明的功能。
checked_items.en: First audit has no version baseline, upgrade auto-activation comparison is not applicable (rule DSH-S02); the plugin's own "check update/self-update" pulls from the official npm mirror and performs version comparison, which is a transparently declared feature.

evidence.zh: 插件对 cordis.patch.yml 的写入仅涉及用户开关与安装条目，并内置宿主基础设施行保护名单；未发现对 sandbox/approval/permission 等安全行做 disabled 覆盖或环境变量降权（对应规则 DSH-P03、DSH-P04 零命中）。
evidence.en: The plugin's writes to cordis.patch.yml only involve user switches and install entries, and it has a built-in host infrastructure row protection list; no disabled overrides or environment variable privilege-lowering on security rows such as sandbox/approval/permission were found (rules DSH-P03, DSH-P04 have zero hits).

evidence.zh: 未对工具预执行、审批请求等 waterfall 安全事件做高优监听或吞掉回调的截断行为（对应规则 DSH-S01 零命中）。
evidence.en: No high-priority listeners for waterfall security events such as tool pre-execution or approval requests, and no truncation behavior that swallows callbacks was found (rule DSH-S01 has zero hits).

evidence.zh: 不适用：首次审计无版本基线可比较，无法进行升级自动激活的版本 diff 判定（对应规则 DSH-S02）。
evidence.en: Not applicable: the first audit has no baseline version to compare, so the version diff determination for upgrade auto-activation cannot be performed (rule DSH-S02).

evidence.zh: 本插件的补丁文件仅声明自身插入条目，未改写任何 inject/intercept 配置，不存在给安全插件追加伪必需服务使其永久挂起的滥用面（对应规则 DSH-P05 零命中）。
evidence.en: This plugin's patch file only declares its own insert entry, does not modify any inject/intercept configuration, and has no abuse surface that appends a fake mandatory service to security plugins to permanently hang them (rule DSH-P05 has zero hits).

checked_items.zh: 插件为 Web 管理面板，路由注册在宿主 webServer 之下（未自行监听端口，对应规则 DSH-S03 零命中），并额外实施回环地址、Host 头、写请求 Origin/Sec-Fetch-Site 三层校验，跨站驱动安装/重启/升级有明确防护。
checked_items.en: The plugin is a web management panel, routes registered under the host webServer (no self-listening ports, rule DSH-S03 has zero hits), and additionally implements three-layer validation of loopback address, Host header, and write-request Origin/Sec-Fetch-Site; cross-site driven install/restart/upgrade has clear protection.

checked_items.zh: 框架一键升级与重启功能通过独立 PowerShell 脚本 + 计划任务执行，含升级前备份、回滚点校验、失败回滚与自守护拉起，均为文档公开声明的业务能力。
checked_items.en: The one-click framework upgrade and restart feature runs through a standalone PowerShell script plus scheduled task, including pre-upgrade backup, rollback point verification, failure rollback, and self-guardian restart, all business capabilities openly declared in documentation.

checked_items.zh: 动态沙箱未启用，运行时行为仅基于静态代码评估；对宿主框架文件的容错补丁机制已在任意代码执行维度留痕说明。
checked_items.en: Dynamic sandbox was not enabled; runtime behavior is evaluated only from static code. The fault-tolerant patch mechanism for host framework files has been noted for tracking in the arbitrary code execution dimension.

evidence.zh: 不适用：本机无认证 RPC 属宿主生态固有风险；本插件未自建监听服务，路由挂在宿主 webServer 下并额外加回环/Host/跨站校验，未扩大该风险面。
evidence.en: Not applicable: unauthenticated RPC on the local machine is an inherent risk of the host ecosystem; this plugin does not create its own listening service, routes hang under the host webServer with additional loopback/Host/cross-site validation, and does not expand that risk surface.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份核验通过：插件声明完整、名称无仿冒、作者无异常信号。
summary.en: Metadata and identity verification passed: plugin declaration is complete, name is not a copycat, author shows no abnormal signals.

summary.zh: 静态扫描未检出恶意 sink；机械命中（DSH-X07、DSH-C05、DSH-X05、DSH-X08、DSH-X03）全部人工复核为良性业务行为。
summary.en: Static scanning found no malicious sinks; mechanical hits (DSH-X07, DSH-C05, DSH-X05, DSH-X08, DSH-X03) were all manually reviewed as benign business behavior.

summary.zh: 无安装钩子、无混淆载荷、无凭据外泄链；对宿主框架文件的容错补丁经复核为公开的窄范围修复。
summary.en: No install hooks, no obfuscated payloads, no credential exfiltration chain; the fault-tolerant patch for host framework files was reviewed as a public narrow-scope fix.

summary.zh: 无模型面注入文本；AI 子代理安装兜底置于明确授权弹窗之后，提示词限定目标且带安全约束。
summary.en: No model-side injection text; AI sub-agent install fallback is placed behind an explicit authorization popup, with prompt scoped to the goal and containing safety constraints.

summary.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（无动态沙盒产物），运行时行为仅静态评估。
summary.en: No dynamic sandbox verification done (no dynamic sandbox artifacts), runtime behavior evaluated only statically.

limits.zh:
未做动态沙箱验证（无动态沙盒产物），运行时行为仅静态评估。

市场数据文件 marketplace/index.json（约 500 个仓库条目）仅抽样核验结构与字段，未逐条通读（单文件超读帽）。

机械规则扫描存在覆盖边界声明（部分规则命中配额耗尽），对裁决关键区域已人工精读 lib/index.js 与 lib/client.js 关键段落（路由、安装、升级、凭据、出站地址）。

插件能力声明按代码实测推断（package.json 无独立能力清单字段）。
limits.en:
No dynamic sandbox verification done (no dynamic sandbox artifacts), runtime behavior evaluated only statically.

The marketplace data file marketplace/index.json (about 500 repo entries) was only sampled for structure and fields, not read line by line (single file exceeds read cap).

Mechanical rule scanning has declared coverage boundaries (some rule hit quotas exhausted); key decision areas were manually read closely, including key sections of lib/index.js and lib/client.js (routes, install, upgrade, credentials, outbound addresses).

Plugin capability declarations were inferred from code measurements (package.json has no separate capability list field).
